title: Full and Final Settlement: The 2-Day Rule, What's Included and What to Do If It's Delayed
seoTitle: Full and Final Settlement: 2-Day Rule, Gratuity and PF
seoDescription: Full and final settlement: wages are due within 2 working days of your last day, gratuity in 30 days, PF in 20. A worked ₹ example and complaint routes.
excerpt: Which F&F items fall inside the two-day window and which run on their own clocks, a line-by-line rupee example, the papers to collect, and where to file a claim if your dues don't arrive.
